                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                delivery_receipt

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                | <a id="work-m190"></a>**M190** | F4 | [M188](#work-m188), [M152](#work-m152), [S14](#work-s14) | **shipped 2026-09-09** — два измеренных дефекта, складывающихся: `IPC.tasksList` резал закрытые задачи на **двадцати** и молчал об этом — плоский массив, по которому всякий считающий считал усечённое множество целым (проект с двумястами завершённых отдавал двадцать); а `PlanSection` показывал число открытых задач под целью **голой цифрой**, поэтому цель с 3 открытыми и 40 сделанными читалась как «3» — количество работы вместо остатка, без знаменателя вовсе. Усечённый источник больше не становится итогом: при обрезке дробь сообщается **нижней границей**, и полоса по ней не рисуется — счёт по обрезанному чтению это удаление узлов арифметикой, что ADR-0042 для этих экранов запрещает. «Ничего не запланировано» — не ноль процентов. Количество посчитано, а не угадано; неудавшийся счёт даёт «никто не считал», а не «ничего не обрезано». **Названо, а не подразумевается:** семейство маршрутов SCR-40 и `GraphSnapshot` не построены — строить графы поверх лгущего чтения значило бы впечь дефект. Четыре подсадки наблюдались падающими. [Карточка](../reports/system.html#task-M190) |

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                entry

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Project history/plan previews, agent history, Task run link, Board source, system map module node.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                exit

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Selected node inspector→exact task/question/run/decision/artifact; Back restores kind/scope/asOf/filters/zoom/selection.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                recipe

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                GraphQuery kind agent_history|project_history|target_plan; route family separate destinations. Journal nodes/edges retain observed/reported/declared origin and accepted/rejected outcome; causal relations explicit. SHOULD query picks plan revision and retains completed membership. Shared renderer infra includes graph/list/outline, not one toggle changes DID into SHOULD.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                preview

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Project DID последние N observed transitions; agent DID exact binding/session scope; SHOULD remaining obligations/progress of declared revision. Always link to corresponding full scope.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                empty graph/list with reason,unlinked nodes,partial/truncated,legacy provenance missing,loading,stale,reconnect,pinned-asOf,invalid edge/cycle diagnostic; not silently remove nodes.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                invariants

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Agent identity must distinguish definition/binding/session; assignments not proof of work.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • DID source history may contain cycles/returns; only normative dependency subgraph subject to DAG rules.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • task_links spawned/follows/blocks directions normalized per meaning; membership != causal edge.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Pagination snapshot stable, exact scope; current no-data is not full empty graph if coverage partial.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                failure_cases

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • 500+ completed tasks; missing parent; denied target; repeated handoff value; same-session multitask; plan revision while user reads older graph.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Historical query interrupted; known edge target not loaded yet shows stub, never dangling silent disappearance.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                migration

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Keep M173 SCR33; migrate existing SCR33 goal-plan route to SCR40 SHOULD explicitly.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • S10 clarifying ADR before routing ships; no silent modification of accepted ADR.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Add missing IDs/correlation/handoff consumption/needs writers in source-owning cards before promising full graph.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                delivery_receipt

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                | <a id="work-m191"></a>**M191** | F4 | [S14](#work-s14) | **shipped 2026-09-09** — измерено: единственный способ увидеть контекст-пак — **запустить сессию**; у `compileContextPack` был ровно один вызывающий, и это запуск, дописывающий `context.compiled@1` и порождающий процесс. Сухой просмотр не пишет **ничего** — ни события, ни строки обращения к памяти — и зовёт тот же компилятор, что запуск: просмотр с собственным отбором разошёлся бы с тем, что показывает. Пак несёт ревизию компилятора и бюджет, поэтому размер стал измерением, а не числом без шкалы. **Честно о доказанности:** утверждение расширено с журнала на обе таблицы, но падающим **не наблюдалось** — три варианта подсадки отвергла сама схема. **Названо, а не подразумевается:** экраны `?view=pack`, lineage и sync не построены — это поверхность F4. [Карточка](../reports/system.html#task-M191) |

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  solution

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  entry

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Project Memory SCR34, task/run pack receipt, decision supplied context ref, system map knowledge source.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  exit

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Next-context dry preview→why included/omitted→exact source; Past pack→recorded artifact/version; source back keeps selected mode.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  recipe

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  load snapshot with per-store errors; pure compile(snapshot,budget,compilerRev); launch persists artifact+lockfile separately. Dry preview never append/context event or spawn. Distinct next vs actual past modes. Retain immutable artifact or complete input revisions+compiler/budget for historical reconstruction.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  preview

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Selected source backend, measured chars/budget, count included/omitted, coverage/freshness. Past pack hash+compiled time+session, no estimate passed as exact.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  states

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  no-history,no-facts,complete,partial-source,over-budget,unsupported-cloud,legacy-incomplete,mirror-behind,mirror-error,preview-outdated; current-vs-past labels always visible.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  #/e/:estate/p/:project/memory?view=next-context&task=:id; ?view=pack&pack=:eventRef; ?view=lineage&fact=:id; ?view=sync

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  canonical_id

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  PackRef = immutable artifact id or context.compiled estate+seq; session alone insufficient for historical snapshot

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  memory.preview({scope,task_ref?,snapshot_seq?,budget_spec,compiler_revision}); memory.pack(PackRef); memory.lineage(FactRef); memory.sync(scope)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  dto

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  PackView {mode,sourceSnapshots,budget:{unit:chars|tokens,value,tokenizer?},used,contentHash,artifactRef?,included:[versionedRefs],omitted:[ref,reason],coverage,compilerRevision}; SyncView has own covered/exported seq

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  read_policy

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Selector order is same pure versioned compiler path; facts operator group then reported group, newest with stable tie-break in selected snapshot; past packs seq desc. Filters store/kind/author/current/superseded. No history distinct from missing artifact; reconnect refreshes next preview only after marking outdated.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  outer_envelope

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Query: canonical ReadEnvelope<T>; mutation: Command<T>/CommandResult<T> from system-contract §4–5. UI lifecycle labels are local, not wire enums. New seq/epoch: decimal strings.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  invariants

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • No inference that supplied context equals complete knowledge.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Char budget is not relabelled token count.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Dry no writes/no sessions; same snapshot+compiler+budget deterministic hash.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Mirror lag only over declared covered event family, not whole journal seq difference.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  failure_cases

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • One source fails; header alone exceeds budget; rename project/brief changes later; missing compiler input versions; cloud selected but not available; mirror ahead/behind/conflict.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  migration

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • S14 read envelope first; immutable pack persistence additive; legacy pack visible as incomplete when exact original cannot be reconstructed.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Full workspace import/backup restore is S12, not prerequisite for read-only preview.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • packDryNoSideEffects; packPartialNotEmpty; packStableHashVersionedInputs; pastPackUnaffectedByRename; mirrorCoverageCursor.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      proposed_symbols

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • apps/desktop/src/shared/readEnvelope.ts: ReadEnvelope, SourceReceipt, applyScopedRead (new)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • apps/desktop/src/main/localStore.ts: readResult/writeAtomic/updateWithRevision

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • apps/desktop/src/main/contextPack.ts: collectContextInputs, compileFromSnapshot

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • renderer MemoryOverviewSection per-source state and generation token; App per-consumer cursor

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      interfaces

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Read

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      shared_contracts.reads; caller query {scope request resolved server-side, generation, filter, minimumCursor?, pageCursor?}; generation client correlation, not authorization

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      LocalRead

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      {value:T,revision:Revision /* opaque */,status:'ready'|'recovered'|'default_missing'|'unreadable',lastGoodAt:string|null,error?:SafeError}

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      LocalWrite

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Command<{patch}> with expected_revision:Revision → canonical CommandResult<{value:T,revision:Revision}>. Committed receipt_ref addresses a durable local operation receipt; conflicts expose current revision. Renderer preserves unsavedPatch independently on every non-committed result; private local persistence is not a journal domain event.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      PackAdmission

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      {purpose:'manual_terminal'|'task_unattended'|'manager',mandatorySources:string[]}; compile result complete/partial/failed; no successful complete if any mandatory read failed

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      flow

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Query through scoped reader returns source receipts and highwater; loader key=(scope,filter,generation). Stale A response ignored after B switch, even if A finishes later.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Overview and misses fetch independently, each source success/error published; optional combined headline only when compatible source snapshots. lastSuccessAt remains previous successful timestamp, not overwritten by failed retry.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Local JSON writes serialize per file in main: validate→merge at expected revision→write temp same dir0600→fsync→atomic rename→fsyncdir→reply saved. Keep validated last-good separate, invalid original moved to quarantined filename; parsefailure never silently persists defaults over lost file.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Settings nested patch per schema, not shallow unknown-property spread. Pin/digest/tabs all use same typed result primitive; coalesce save safely but don't acknowledge revisions skipped. Local preferences never journal as estate state.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Manual terminal may start in explicitly labelled degraded context when identity/rules intact; unattended agent/manager authority inputs unavailable→admission deferred. Current catch-and-log in bundle replaced typed readiness; this is local behaviour fix before full S12 restore.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      invariants

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • No data crosses scope through cache; authorization loss immediately invalidates old scoped value.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • source unavailable ≠ no rows; mixed counts cannot produce known miss rate.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • minimumCursor unavailable returns pending/unavailable reason instead of stale exact decision. Eventual search can show lag with exact reader fallback.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Seen cursor advances only for payload successfully displayed/acknowledged by that feature; no globalcursor bulkack of failed memory misses.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • In-memory optimistic preference and persisted preference kept separate; restart returns last committed file.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      migration

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Wrap existing result types via adapters first; independent MemoryOverview counts already rows:null, do not regress.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • No preference copy into SQL. Introduce versioned JSON envelope and tolerant read of legacy plain JSON; first successful save upgrades atomic format.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Context collector separates source IO from pure rendering; old caller compile still adaptable while result propagation across bundle+IPC+whoami delivered same change.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        solution

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        research

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        touches

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        contextPack.ts, main IPC reads, renderer loaders/App catch-up, settings.ts/localStore.ts

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        observable_effect

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Ошибка одного источника не превращается в пустую память и не стирает успешно загруженную часть; local save не врёт об успехе.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        falsifier

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Fault-injected sources/write denied/late A→B deliver explicit partial or error while preserving correct old data/draft; any success/empty lie fails.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        flow

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Query through scoped reader returns source receipts and highwater; loader key=(scope,filter,generation). Stale A response ignored after B switch, even if A finishes later.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Overview and misses fetch independently, each source success/error published; optional combined headline only when compatible source snapshots. lastSuccessAt remains previous successful timestamp, not overwritten by failed retry.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Local JSON writes serialize per file in main: validate→merge at expected revision→write temp same dir0600→fsync→atomic rename→fsyncdir→reply saved. Keep validated last-good separate, invalid original moved to quarantined filename; parsefailure never silently persists defaults over lost file.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Settings nested patch per schema, not shallow unknown-property spread. Pin/digest/tabs all use same typed result primitive; coalesce save safely but don't acknowledge revisions skipped. Local preferences never journal as estate state.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Manual terminal may start in explicitly labelled degraded context when identity/rules intact; unattended agent/manager authority inputs unavailable→admission deferred. Current catch-and-log in bundle replaced typed readiness; this is local behaviour fix before full S12 restore.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        visible_result

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Fresh/stale/partial/error named on each panel; save error retains draft and exact retry; pack preview states missing inputs. Early M191 read-only preview consumes this, no wait on backup.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            delivery_receipt

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            | <a id="work-s15"></a>**S15** | F2 | [S04](#work-s04), [S14](#work-s14) | **shipped 2026-09-09** — измерено: тик — `setInterval` с двумя производителями и **без расписки**. `routine.ran@1` говорит, что рутина отработала; ничто не говорит, что цикл состоялся, поэтому после закрытого приложения ничто не отличает «ничего не было должно» от «никто не смотрел» — ADR-0037 говорил это умолчанием, а пустая лента читается как сдержанное обещание. И предела не было: день офлайна запускал все должные рутины в одну секунду. **Собственный повтор, исправленный здесь:** наблюдатель M179 не имел вызывающего — та же форма, о которой был сам M179, повторённая в том же прогоне; цикл теперь его зовёт. **Вскрыто пределом:** проба тика была зелёной, запуская **двадцать пять** сессий за тик — фиксированный эстейт копил рутины между прогонами, а `spawnsIn(project)` считал один проект. Проба чистит за собой. **Названо, а не подразумевается:** порядок в пределе — порядок хранилища; справедливость по давности долга не построена, поэтому рутина позади длинной очереди ждёт несколько проходов. Три подсадки наблюдались падающими. [Карточка](../reports/system.html#task-S15) |

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              solution

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              choice

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              One CyclePort for routine, chain, hygiene, retro, letters and manual wake; each producer declares policy and receipts. A cycle invocation is orchestration, not automatically a TaskRun or fabricated task. Before UI M186 the producers already expose truthful health/outcomes.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              states

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • CycleDefinition enabled/paused/retired plus host availability observed/unobserved; independent of execution.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Window pending → leased → running → completed|skipped_no_delta|partial|failed_known|outcome_unknown; pending/leased → cancelled_before_dispatch. completed/skipped advance watermark; partial advances only explicitly committed subwindows, unknown never advances uncertain work.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Active invocation can waiting/backoff without burning a worker; persisted next_eligible_at and bounded attempt budget; manual wake coalesces with eligible current window.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              transactions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • requestCycle locks cycle slot; deterministic window key dedupes manual/cadence/Board signals, merges unconsumed event range to pending. acquireCycle assigns epoch and owner host_generation under DB clock; role cycles additionally pin role_slot_id/binding_revision and current role epoch.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Before work persist through_seq, input ids/hash, policy and definition revision. Producer command keys derive window+logical operation, not transient attempt number. After accepted command results and checkpoint persist atomically, completeWindow advances completed watermark. Late completion by previous fence refused.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Wake-worthy event class registry ignores heartbeat/tool trace/checkpoint and self-only maintenance; consume each eligible source event once. A worker result sharing causal root is eligible; no blanket suppression of all descendants. Bound chain hop/iteration and total model/time/cost budget independently.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              time_policy

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              Interval routines use UTC interval origin and coalesce_missed_once. Calendar letters use timezone + calendar day key with preserved one-per-day windows; catchup each bounded by max starts per poll. Persist DST policy: nonexistent local trigger→next valid time; ambiguous→first occurrence, one logical window. Record calculated UTC bounds and tzdb/runtime version. If policy changes, new definition revision; never reinterpret old window keys.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              app_off

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              A disabled/offline host cannot produce new health receipts. Last observer timestamp and reason remain visible. No always-on claim; next launch processes explicit catch-up. Unknown crash gap cannot be labeled confirmed app closed. Diagnostic source-down overlay is separate from business success.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              interfaces

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              new_files

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • apps/desktop/src/main/cycleCoordinator.ts:requestCycle,acquireCycle,checkpointCycle,completeCycle

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • apps/desktop/src/shared/cycleWindow.ts:windowFor,catchupWindows

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • apps/desktop/src/main/cycleRegistry.ts:producerDefinitions

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              schema

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • cycle_definitions {cycle_id,revision,estate_id,project_id?,kind,placement,role_slot_id?,cadence,timezone,catchup_policy,eligible_event_types,limits,enabled}; PK(cycle_id,revision)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • cycle_windows {window_id,cycle_id,definition_revision,window_key,from_seq,through_seq,completed_through_seq,state,input_hash,checkpoint_ref}; UNIQUE(cycle_id,definition_revision,window_key)

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • cycle_invocations {invocation_id,window_id,attempt_no,owner_host_generation,lease_epoch,role_epoch?,started_seq,finished_seq,outcome,error_ref,next_eligible_at,budget_ref}; UNIQUE(window_id,attempt_no) and one active leased owner per cycle policy

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              commands

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • requestCycle({cycleId,triggerRef,eventThroughSeq?}) → window id/coalesced

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • acquireCycle({windowId,expectedDefinitionRevision}) → lease epoch/input window

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • checkpointCycle({invocationId,expectedEpoch,checkpointRef,committedCommandRefs,throughSeq}) → checkpoint receipt

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • completeCycle({invocationId,expectedEpoch,outcome,completedThroughSeq}) → summary receipt

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              invariants

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Watermark advances only past durably accounted input.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Manual/cadence/Board triggers use same admission and budgets.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Last run started is not last successful outcome.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Replay reconstructs receipts/epoch values, never dispatches external work.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              failure_cases

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Two hosts acquire same window → one owner.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Crash after command commit before checkpoint → lookup same command key and resume, no duplicate effect.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Outdated role binding completes cycle → fence reject; successor can reconcile prior receipts but not inherit live authority blindly.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              migration

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Adapt current routine.ran/paused@1 to legacy started/paused observations; never invent completed receipts from those rows.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Add explicit definitions for existing routine/chain/notifier first; future producer absent reads not_configured, not healthy.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • S04 launch port reused; small CyclePort module need not wait for M186 or a model. Reference durable engine binding remains ADR0022; local profile truthful.
