                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  {basisCursor,policyRevision,rankedItems:[{id,priority,components}],hygiene:Action[],settlementCandidates:[{questionRef,factRefs,criticality,trustRequirement}],digest,unavailableCapabilities,sourceQuality}

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Executor

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  applyCorePlan(plan,TrustedContext,CommandMeta) → typed per-action receipts; revalidates references andpolicy attransactiontime, never blind execute pure output

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  flow

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Reuse existing questionPriority/rankBoard/projectWeight/ceoTrustFor/digestOf/attentionOf, not duplicate formulas.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Pure plan computes derivedviews and candidateactions; absolute time injected fromsnapshot. No DB/client/model imports insharedpurecore.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Every mutation callsone domaincommand/checker. Settlement candidate only current allowedscope citedbasis + requiredtrust + independent authority; missing/contradictoryfacts→ask, not guessedanswer.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Core usable with ModelPortnull; advisory capability absent explicitly. No claim productcomplete merelycore delivered.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Cycle tick calls scoped core through S15 receipt when recurring; manualquery can showdeterministicview without creatingtick.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  invariants

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Pure plan itself grantsnoauthority; stale planrejected atcommit.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Unknowntrust clamp ask alreadyworks and mustbereused.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Ordering reproducible and explainable; no usercontrolledpriorityscalar accepted fromagent.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Core never approves ownpromotion/checkerrules; fixed core independent ofselectedmanager provider.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        {invocationId,turnId,attemptId,commandCorrelationId,modelRef,modelRevision,packRef,messages:NormalizedMessage[],tools:VersionedToolSchema[],responseSchema?:JsonSchema,budget:{deadlineAt,maxInputTokens,maxOutputTokens,maxCostMicrounits:number|null},continuation:{vendorRef,opaqueStateRef}|null}; AbortSignal transport only, secrets resolvedinmain

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Port

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        interface ModelPort { capabilities():Promise<CapabilityRead>; generate(req:ModelRequest,signal:AbortSignal):AsyncIterable<ModelEvent>; probe(req:ProbeRequest,signal):Promise<HealthReceipt> }; configuredPort:ModelPort|null

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Event

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        {type:'started',attemptId,providerRequestId?}|{type:'text_delta',...}|{type:'tool_call',callId,name,input}|{type:'usage',usageObservation}|{type:'completed',stopReason:'end_turn'|'tool_calls'|'length'|'safety'|'stop',providerStateRef?}|{type:'failed',failure:{code:'auth'|'rate_limit'|'unavailable'|'timeout'|'invalid_output'|'cancelled'|'unsupported'|'unknown',retryable,retryAfterMs?,dispatchState:'not_sent'|'sent'|'unknown'}}

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ResultGuard

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        A complete turn requires exactly one terminal event and all toolcall inputs fully parsed+schema validated. Partial text not semantic Board output; tools executed only bymanager service.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        flow

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Separate ModelPort for builtinmodelcall from NativeManagerRunner (whole externalagent loop). Both use samemanager tools andusagecontract; CLI is not API-key fallbackadapter.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Health read returns not_configured separately unavailable; nofakeModelPort productiondefault. Syntheticfake registered only in fixture composition.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Adapter normalizes observablecontent/toolcalls/usage, stores opaqueproviderstate safely ifrequired byprovider; no parsing orinventinghiddenreasoning/rationale. Recorded rationale is explicit outputfield atproposaltool.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Resolve credentials/config only in main perapprovedpool/context. Versionpin adapter/modelcapabilities; unsupportedrequiredtools/structuredoutput→capabilityunavailable before paidcall.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Abort stops reads/dispatch as supported, but networksent/unknown remains receipt; never returncancelledbeforeeffect ifalreadyexecuted.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        invariants

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • No provider output can supplyauthscope/grants/epoch.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Provider reportedcost is observedestimate notbillingtruth; missingfieldsnull not0.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • No hardcodedlatest model names/windows/prices; versionedconfig supplies and tests snapshot.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Rawtextcomplete doesnotcommitanything; all statechanges via sharedcommandports.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • No directprovider SDK import in renderer/sharedpurecore.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Checker перед любой записью предложения

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            d28c321ccca8c4ef0e803ebea5b7ba056e88bc5d

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            delivery_receipt

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            | <a id="work-m168"></a>**M168** | F3 | [S06](#work-s06) | **shipped 2026-09-09** — измерено: два входа писали события предложений и проверяли разное — агентская поверхность знала только `mayChain`, операторский путь только «существует и не решено», после чего создавал задачу по `project_id`, ни разу не спросив, есть ли ещё такой проект. Общей строки проверки не было. **Контракт сам запрещал ответ:** `decide` был `Promise<void>`, поэтому единственным способом отказать оставалось исключение — то есть «Error invoking remote method» в рендерере (M106). Теперь отказ это расписка с кодом причины, средством и признаком `retryable`; недоступный чекер отказывается коммитить и говорит «попробуйте снова», что не то же самое, что «нет». Решение стало одной транзакцией: блокировка строки, перепроверка под ней и оба события вместе — прежде два окна оба читали `decided_at = null` и оба проходили, а падение между записями оставляло задачу без решения. Обход держат ворота `check-checker.mjs`, а не намерение: они нашли второй вход в минуту написания. Четыре подсадки наблюдались падающими. [Карточка](../reports/system.html#task-M168) |

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            solution

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            entry

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Любой человек/agent/model proposal проходит один предметный service, до authoritative write.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            exit

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Typed checked command либо rejection receipt, который UI связывает с сохранённым draft/proposal.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            recipe

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Schemas для proposal variants, validators ссылок/версий/authority/eligibility; transactional revalidation на commit. Checker не оценивает скрытые мысли и не доказывает истинность смысла свободного текста.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            preview

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Reason, affected object, remedy; diagnostic source refs за раскрытием.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            states

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            validating/accepted/rejected/retryable/stale; rejected != unavailable checker.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            interfaces

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            route

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Остаётся исходная Board/task/decision view; receipt открывается в source inspector

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            canonical_id

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            proposal/command id + validator_version + input_snapshot_seq

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            dto

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            CheckResult = {ok:true,checkedCommand,inputRevisions} | {ok:false,reasonCode,fieldPath?,evidenceRefs,remedy,retryable}

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            command

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            checkAndCommit(command,actorContext), no renderer direct DB writer

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            read_policy

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            No independent primary screen; rejection receipts ordered newest recorded seq in source detail/Inbox. Filter reason/command/actor optional diagnostics. Checker timeout is retryable refusal to commit, never valid.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            outer_envelope

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Query: canonical ReadEnvelope<T>; mutation: Command<T>/CommandResult<T> from system-contract §4–5. UI lifecycle labels are local, not wire enums. New seq/epoch: decimal strings.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            invariants

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Нельзя bypass checker через вторую IPC/MCP entry.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Model output проверяется до употребления, а не after-the-fact badge.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Error/timeout checker fail closed, draft не теряется.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            failure_cases

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Well-typed malicious refs, different project, superseded basis, invalid reorder band, concurrent invalidation.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Reject payload содержит secret → safe redacted receipt, не raw prompt в Inbox.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            migration

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Versioned reason enum и adapters; no new user workflow just for validation.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            tests

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • checkerPlantedInvalidProposalEachVariant; positive control for every rejection.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • checkerAllEntrypointsSharedBoundary; concurrent source revision changes.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      {observationId,attemptId,invocationId,providerRequestId?,vendorMessageId?,nativeConversationId?,usageScope:'step'|'turn'|'query_call'|'call_segment'|'invocation',segmentId,provider/model/adapterRevision,measurement:'provider_reported'|'host_estimated'|'billing_reconciled'|'unknown',aggregation:'delta'|'cumulative',coverage:'main_agent'|'whole_tree'|'unknown',tokens:{input:number|null,output:number|null,cacheRead:number|null,cacheWrite:number|null},cost:{microunits:number|null,currency:'USD'|null,basis:'client_estimate'|'price_config'|'invoice'|'unknown',priceRef:Ref|null},capturedAt,sourceRef}

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      ModelCalled

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      {attemptId,invocationId,turnId,providerRef,modelRevision,dispatchStatus,startedAt,endedAt,outcome,usageObservationRefs[],effectiveUsageRef|null,priceConfigRevision|null,redactionReceipt}; exact event version reserved atimplementation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      Rollup

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      {scopeRef,knownTokens,unknownAttemptCount,estimatedCostMicrounits,billedCostMicrounits|null,coverage,asOfCursor,priceVersions[]}; don't sumstep and call cumulative intoone total

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      flow

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • One host attempt ID perdispatch, one provider message ID dedup withinattempt. Diagnosticattempttrace S05 allcalls; model.called terminaloutcome joinsusage, notreplacementtrace.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Adapter marks scope and cumulative/reset semantics explicitly. Reducer prefers latest cumulative for a segment, fallsback summedunique steps whenaggregateabsent, neverboth. For providerreset closes previoussegment withlastcumulative andstartsnewsegment; hostinvocationbudgetunchanged.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Costestimate distinct observedtokenusage andauthoritativebilling. Currentpriceconfigvalidityknown atcall; historical estimatespinned, laterbilling reconciliation newreceipt notrewriteoriginal.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • NativeCLI subscription/OAuth may showtokens/quota andclientestimate, no perprojectchargedprice invented. Lack of finalusage createsunknown attempt even ifexitedwith0.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Per-turn orsubagent usage markedmainonly/whole_tree; main usage cannotlabeltotalestateusage; adaptercapabilityverdict reflectsavailablecoverage.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      invariants

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • No floatarithmetic forpersistedmoney: integermicrounitswithcurrencyandroundingpolicy. Nullunknown separatefrom0measured.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Duplicate terminal/usageevents idempotent; sum by normalizedreceiptownership.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Usageprose fromagenttool untrusted andcannotadjustbudgetbalance.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Redaction beforepersist; no rawprompts/secret headers inusage event.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            delivery_receipt

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            | <a id="work-m176"></a>**M176** | F5 | [S05](#work-s05), [M155](#work-m155), [M168](#work-m168) | **shipped 2026-09-09** — измерено и сказано прямо: **профиля менеджера и пути его активации в дереве нет**, поэтому это не забор над существующей дверью, а корпус и суждение, которые обязаны появиться до того, как дверь построят — порядок из самой карточки. [`managerEval.ts`](../../apps/desktop/src/shared/managerEval.ts#evaluateTrajectory): жёсткое нарушение **не компенсируется** метриками (суммирующая оценка рано или поздно допустит утечку эстейта, потому что арифметика делает это неизбежным); неполный захват даёт `inconclusive`, никогда не pass, и не fail — субъект не наказан за наш сток; ожидаемые unknown должны совпасть **точно**, потому что *меньше* значит, что разрешили неразрешимое, а проверка «нет unknown» это поощряет. Вердикт не разрешение: функции, превращающей отчёт в допуск, нет намеренно, и [гейт](../../scripts/check-eval.mjs) отказывает любой, чьё имя на неё похоже. [Корпус](../../apps/desktop/src/shared/managerCorpus.ts#CORPUS) — девять фикстур, каждая сеет **реальный дефект этого репозитория** (S03.boundary, M124, S02, S03.effects, M182, S03, M168, M177, S05), и гейт разрешает каждое имя против реестра: фикстура, ссылающаяся на работу, которой здесь не было, — выдуманная. Каждое известное оценщику нарушение обязано кем-то засеиваться: забор, который никто не видел срабатывающим, — это дисциплина подсадок, применённая к самой оценке. **Названо, а не подразумевается:** пилота на двух реальных раннерах нет и он не заявлен — детерминированный fake не доказывает поведение установленного бинарника, это отдельный гейт S08. Заодно исправлено ограничение харнесса: `code-stats` читал 30-дневную историю (140 КБ, 2.3 с) без защиты и под нагрузкой CI умирал на unhandled rejection, не сообщая ничего; продукт этот отказ обрабатывал честно. Семь подсадок наблюдались падающими. [Карточка](../reports/system.html#task-M176) |

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  interfaces

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  RoleSlot

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  {role_slot_id,estate_id,scope_kind:'estate'|'project',project_id:null|string,role:'ceo'|'product-manager',configured_binding_revision:Revision,epoch:Seq,runtime_state:'idle'|'admitting'|'running'|'transitioning'|'suspended'|'unknown'}; unique semantic scope+role

New provider admission+scope/policy checked beforeactivation

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  {cycle_invocation_id,role_slot_ref,epoch,trigger:'manual'|'board_delta'|'cadence'|'addressed_mail',trigger_refs[],signal_start_seq:Seq,signal_end_seq:Seq,window_key,causation_id,excluded_self_event_kinds[],source_readiness}; inclusivebatch semantics documented; consumed seq committed onlyafterdurableoutcomes

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Readiness

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  {configured:{binding_ref,scope,placement},host:{status:'online'|'offline'|'unknown'|'not_supported',last_observed_at,source_ref},authority:{status:'active'|'suspended'|'transitioning',epoch},runner:{status:'certified'|'uncertified'|'unavailable',profile_hash,capability_gaps},invocation:{state,id,last_outcome_ref}|null}; wrapscommon ReadEnvelope

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  flow

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Adopt D-MGR-01/02 with new ADR + sibling version. Canonical roles are ceo/product-manager; arbitrary created-agent displayname/role not auto migrated. One configured governance assignment persists during safe handoff, runtime lease may be absent; never two admitted writers.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Bind preview validates provider/admission/runner profile, account pool, placement, exact tool schemas, budget and source scope. Available CLI binary alone isn't certified. Existing Codex terminal row cannot be offered as workingmanager without new adapter proof.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • S15 wake service coalesces Board delta/manual/cadence/addressedmail into fixed authorized signal batch. Ignore own bookkeeping by explicitcausation/type allowlist; business effects that produce genuinely new externalobligation stayeligible. Samewindow+watermark replay returns samecycle/invocation, no paidstorm.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Admission transaction checks current slotbindingrevision, trust, budget, host lease and readiness; creates manager_invocation+operational lease/fencing token+spawn intent atomically. Invocation withouttask nevercreatesfakeprojecttask/TaskRun. Afterspawnfailure record failed invocation andknownunusedbudgetrefund; afterunknownlaunch reconcile first.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Manager pack includes only authorized Board slice/openquestions, currenthumanbasis, projectweights/trust/components, prior durable decisions and addressed mailbox; exactpacklock+contenthash beforedispatch. Empty source unavailable doesnotbecome emptyBoard. No agent's narrative remembered as independentdecision.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Built-in runner callsM175 viaModelPort. NativeClaude runner executes one bounded headless invocation using explicit profile and dedicated ephemeral directory; streamadapter maps nativeconversation/toolresult/usage. Capture vendorconversationref separately fromFabricSession andManagerInvocation.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Manager native profile selected recommendation: built-in tools disabled through supported --tools configuration, only FabricmanagerMCP definitions configured; permissionmode dontAsk and exactnamedMCP autoapprove policy; plugins/projectconfig/ambienthooks unavailable by isolated config, environment allowlist, filesystem/network restrictions. Certification tests inventory and refusals on pinnedCLI build. --strict-mcp-config alone insufficient; no blanket canUseTool interceptionpromise.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Initialmanager wakes start fresh nativeconversation. Optional explicitresume requiressamebinding/epoch-compatible authorization, profile, accessiblehistory and adapterinvocation-scoped cancellation/ack. Never continue-latest-cwd. Missingnativehistory→fresh fromFabricpack with resume_unavailable receipt; not pretendresumed.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Every manager mutation revalidates slotepoch+binding+policy+currentbasis underDBtransaction. Revokedoldtoken can'tcommit evenif MCPtransport stillalive. Agent cannot choose a humanactor, approve ownprivacypromotion or bypasschecker throughprose.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Handoff follows system-contract order: stopadmissions→boundedcheckpoint/drain→invalidateoldepoch→newbindingadmission→newcontext/epoch→acknowledgedcontinuation. Ifoldprocessunresponsive checkpoint unknown and fence stillrevoked; preservependingeffects forreconcile. Newmanagerreceives durablemailbox/pendingquestionrefs, notopaquevendorstate. Configuredassignment and runtimeavailability distinguished.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Afterprocessrestart cyclehost reconciles admitted/dispatchinginvocations before newadmission; stalehostlease doesn'tprove nativechild stopped. Localappclosed cannotrun; futurehosted runtime needsactualhostheartbeat/executorcontract, notproviderlabel.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  invariants

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • One authoritative manager command surface; directSQL/API credentials neverprovided toexternalagent.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • All outstandingnativeconversation/toolcall/usage refs carry ownerbinding and epoch; wrongscope/nativehistory reuse rejected.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Host activeepoch fence checked after any awaited work beforecommit; delayedchecker/modeloutput cannotretainexpiredright.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • PM sees only project; CEO crossproject coordination sees authorized summaries but rawprojectcontent requires policy/classification; no unlimitedestateSQL.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Native transcript is evidence of agentclaim, not businessoutput; explicit tool commandreceipt is what changedwork.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Configuredactive CEO required by siblinggovernance; runtime absent/suspended duringhandoff allowed, notnoconfiguredCEO.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Conformance matrix states missingreadiness/trace/cancel/permissioncapability; unverified externalprofile notenabled asautonomousmanager.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  touches

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  canonical contract adoption, agent_bindings/role_slots projection, manager service/runner/bundle/credentials, S15 wake/mailbox, Board+pack

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  observable_effect

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Замена built-in/external manager сохраняет решения и память, отзывает старые полномочия; невозможны два одновременно пишущих менеджера одного scope.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  falsifier

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  Delayed old-epoch command commits after handoff, foreign/native state becomes authority, or appoff labelled running⇒contract failed.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  flow

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Adopt D-MGR-01/02 with new ADR + sibling version. Canonical roles are ceo/product-manager; arbitrary created-agent displayname/role not auto migrated. One configured governance assignment persists during safe handoff, runtime lease may be absent; never two admitted writers.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Bind preview validates provider/admission/runner profile, account pool, placement, exact tool schemas, budget and source scope. Available CLI binary alone isn't certified. Existing Codex terminal row cannot be offered as workingmanager without new adapter proof.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • S15 wake service coalesces Board delta/manual/cadence/addressedmail into fixed authorized signal batch. Ignore own bookkeeping by explicitcausation/type allowlist; business effects that produce genuinely new externalobligation stayeligible. Samewindow+watermark replay returns samecycle/invocation, no paidstorm.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Admission transaction checks current slotbindingrevision, trust, budget, host lease and readiness; creates manager_invocation+operational lease/fencing token+spawn intent atomically. Invocation withouttask nevercreatesfakeprojecttask/TaskRun. Afterspawnfailure record failed invocation andknownunusedbudgetrefund; afterunknownlaunch reconcile first.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Manager pack includes only authorized Board slice/openquestions, currenthumanbasis, projectweights/trust/components, prior durable decisions and addressed mailbox; exactpacklock+contenthash beforedispatch. Empty source unavailable doesnotbecome emptyBoard. No agent's narrative remembered as independentdecision.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Built-in runner callsM175 viaModelPort. NativeClaude runner executes one bounded headless invocation using explicit profile and dedicated ephemeral directory; streamadapter maps nativeconversation/toolresult/usage. Capture vendorconversationref separately fromFabricSession andManagerInvocation.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Manager native profile selected recommendation: built-in tools disabled through supported --tools configuration, only FabricmanagerMCP definitions configured; permissionmode dontAsk and exactnamedMCP autoapprove policy; plugins/projectconfig/ambienthooks unavailable by isolated config, environment allowlist, filesystem/network restrictions. Certification tests inventory and refusals on pinnedCLI build. --strict-mcp-config alone insufficient; no blanket canUseTool interceptionpromise.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Initialmanager wakes start fresh nativeconversation. Optional explicitresume requiressamebinding/epoch-compatible authorization, profile, accessiblehistory and adapterinvocation-scoped cancellation/ack. Never continue-latest-cwd. Missingnativehistory→fresh fromFabricpack with resume_unavailable receipt; not pretendresumed.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Every manager mutation revalidates slotepoch+binding+policy+currentbasis underDBtransaction. Revokedoldtoken can'tcommit evenif MCPtransport stillalive. Agent cannot choose a humanactor, approve ownprivacypromotion or bypasschecker throughprose.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Handoff follows system-contract order: stopadmissions→boundedcheckpoint/drain→invalidateoldepoch→newbindingadmission→newcontext/epoch→acknowledgedcontinuation. Ifoldprocessunresponsive checkpoint unknown and fence stillrevoked; preservependingeffects forreconcile. Newmanagerreceives durablemailbox/pendingquestionrefs, notopaquevendorstate. Configuredassignment and runtimeavailability distinguished.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • Afterprocessrestart cyclehost reconciles admitted/dispatchinginvocations before newadmission; stalehostlease doesn'tprove nativechild stopped. Localappclosed cannotrun; futurehosted runtime needsactualhostheartbeat/executorcontract, notproviderlabel.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  | <a id="work-s03-boundary"></a>**S03.boundary** | F0 | [S02.store](#work-s02-store) | **shipped 2026-09-08** — доказано до починки: `floored_needs_grant` принимал грант истёкший, потреблённый, для другой цели и чужого estate, хотя комментарий обещал, что код в обход политики упрётся в эту строку. Теперь флорнутый эффект ссылается не на грант, а на **резервацию**, создать которую может только `reserve_effect` (security definer; прямой INSERT отозван у всех ролей, как миграция 6 закрыла дверь проекций). Единственность — частичный уникальный индекс, а не последовательность операторов. P27: 13 утверждений с контролями. [Карточка](../reports/system.html#task-S03-boundary) |
